notes.title: 0.4.4 Update notes + Roadmap changes
notes.content:
[b]Content[/b]
-New skills for Hye and Mari
-New items have been added
-The corner store has been replaced by a clothing store, allowing you to buy alternate costumes for party members. For now, only a costume for Isidora is available. The costume is buyable upon unlocking the catacombs
-New side-story available after unlocking the catacombs
[b]Visual/Audio[/b]
-Several new character sprites
-New UI icons
[b]Fixes/writing changes/Adjustments[/b]
-Hye's rank 1 will now give him the new skill "Retribution."
-Various writing changes
-Entering and exiting the catacombs will now fully restore the party
-The amount of EXP required for levels has been adjusted
-Catacombs encounters have been made more difficult
-Vulnerable is now removed at the end of the battle
-Upgraded weapons will now have improved hit rates along with other unique bonuses, depending on the weapon
-Adjusted MN cost of higher-level skills
- Max MN has been reduced for all party members to encourage the use of MN recovering items
-Mari's skills "Pommel bash" and "Sidewinder" have been merged into a single skill called "Stinger," Given at level one
-Mari has a new skill, "stinger strike," Learned at level 7
-----------------------

This is a significant one, and it has quickly become apparent to me that I can't keep up with the roadmap I initially had.  

Replacing hundreds of art assets and adding major story additions within a few months just doesn't seem plausible right now.

So things are gonna slow down for a bit. An update will still come at the end of every month, but the goals on the roadmap just can't be met with the ideas I have in mind. 

I want the next batch of story content to make a [b]big[/b] jump in quality, so it's gonna take a while. In the meantime, I'll focus on improving the visuals and sound.

Thanks for playing.

notes.title: 0.4.3 patch notes + Delayed content
notes.content:
0.4.3 Update notes

[b]Content[/b]
-Hye hangout rank 1 has been added
-30 minutes of main story added

[b]Visual/Audio[/b]
-Various adjustments to environment sprites to make them fit the intended art style better

[b]Fixes/writing changes/Adjustments[/b]
-Various writing adjustments
-Card tanker, block golem, and fairy doll are now immune to bleed
-Mari's summon sword buffs are now more powerful
-Slight changes to Sthalgrave
-Fixed a mistake where Deia's hangout rank gave HP instead of Attack
-Version number will now be shown on the title screen

------------------------------------------------

First update, but it's a fairly minor one.

Unfortunately, I wasn't able to meet the roadmap for this month. Replacing character sprites has been more challenging than I thought, but it's coming along!

Here's a teaser!
[img]https://m.gjcdn.net/fireside-post-image/700/41741178-ll-fch937sb-v4.webp[/img]

I'm going to add the changes meant for this update into the next update, which will make it much beefier than initially planned!

Thanks for playing!
